slices.title: Typed refusal for today's gate and catalogue
slices.summary: Adds the mp-contracts model_entitlement module (typed model_not_entitled and model_entitlement_unavailable codes, reasons, builders) and changes the model-gateway deployment allowlist refusal from an untyped 400 to a typed 403 body, gRPC PERMISSION_DENIED and an SSE error frame, with a content-free refusal catalogue, its contract-sync gate and the SPA refusal mapping (Norwegian first). No proto change; rollback is a revert.

slices.title: org-core store, resolve, explain, admin and machine API
slices.summary: Adds org-core storage and APIs for per-org and per-role model policies (allow and deny lists, max_effort, min_privacy_tier, surface defaults) with revisions, append-only history and RLS, the admin GET and PUT route, the explain route and an internal route for inference-core, plus the model-gateway scope and a new inference-core principal limited to model-entitlement read. Nothing calls it until S3.

slices.title: Matcher, GetModelAccess and inference-core PEP
slices.summary: Adds the additive GetModelAccess RPC and ListModelsResponse.access metadata, an inference-core entitlement client (1 s timeout, single-flight, 30 s TTL cache, stale bounds 900 s restrictive and 120 s unrestricted) and the enforcement point in infer, infer_stream, ListModels and the provider fallback chain (pinned pre-check before cache, per-candidate permit, tool-ladder prune), behind MODEL_ENTITLEMENT_MODE off|shadow|enforce (default off). Service principals are exempt.
